answers.answer: Article 6 remains in force as of 3 September 2026. In full English translation: “The University of Chile has authority to recognize, revalidate and validate professional qualifications obtained abroad, without prejudice to international treaties. It is also responsible for giving an opinion on international agreements or treaties concerning higher education that the Government of Chile is interested in concluding with other governments or international and foreign entities.” The current provision does not contain the words “privativa y excluyente.”
answers.quote: A la Universidad de Chile le corresponde la atribución de reconocer, revalidar y convalidar títulos profesionales obtenidos en el extranjero
answers.note: BCN identifies 27 March 2024 as the latest consolidated version; no subsequent repeal or replacement was shown as of 3 September 2026.

answers.answer: Yes. Exempt Decree No. 384 was issued on 17 June 2026, published on 17 July 2026 and became applicable on 17 August 2026. Maximum charges are: application/admissibility, 2 UTM; academic analysis, 3 UTM; revalidation examinations or final-degree activities, 15 UTM in total; additional curricular activities, 20 UTM in total; and any diploma or certificate fee equal to the institution’s pre-established fee for an equivalent domestic document. Thus recognition has a 5-UTM procedural ceiling plus the document fee. Revalidation can theoretically reach 40 UTM plus the document fee if both additional stages are required. The UTM value is that applicable in the month each stage is paid. These are ceilings, not mandatory actual prices: institutions may charge less or grant reductions or exemptions.
answers.quote: Los aranceles establecidos en el presente acto administrativo tendrán el carácter de máximos
answers.note: The act was signed exactly four months after publication of Decree 174, although it was published one month later. LeyChile record: https://www.bcn.cl/leychile/navegar?idNorma=1226114.

answers.answer: No public applicant-facing central platform, public directory of participating universities, or updated MINEDUC applicant guidance page could be verified. Article 7 requires applications to be filed directly with each institution’s Coordinating Unit. Article 8 describes the central platform as an institution-facing system for uploading applicant records within five working days and preventing simultaneous duplicate applications; it is not defined as a public application portal. Consequently, the internal platform’s operational status cannot be established from the public web. MINEDUC’s current “Trámite digital” page still identifies the University of Chile route and provides no Decree-174 participating-institution directory.
answers.quote: Las solicitudes de reconocimiento o revalidación deberán presentarse ante la Unidad Coordinadora de la institución de educación superior nacional
answers.note: Checked the Subsecretaría de Educación Superior and MINEDUC sites, their Trámite digital page (https://educacionsuperior.mineduc.cl/tramite-digital/), LeyChile, Diario Oficial, and searches for the platform’s exact statutory name. This does not establish that the internal system is non-operational.

answers.answer: Fourteen state universities satisfy the institutional-accreditation threshold on 3 September 2026: Universidad de Chile — Excellence, 7 years, expires 23 December 2032; Universidad de Santiago de Chile — Excellence, 7 years, expires 25 February 2028; Universidad de Talca — Excellence, 7 years, expires 1 June 2033; Universidad de Tarapacá — Excellence, 6 years, expires 22 June 2029; Universidad de Valparaíso — Excellence, 6 years, expires 8 March 2029; Universidad Arturo Prat — Advanced, 5 years, expires 6 July 2027; Universidad de Antofagasta — Advanced, 5 years, expires 7 September 2027; Universidad de Atacama — Advanced, 5 years, expires 1 April 2031; Universidad del Bío-Bío — Advanced, 5 years, expires 15 January 2030; Universidad de La Frontera — Advanced, 5 years, expires 3 September 2030; Universidad de La Serena — Advanced, 5 years, expires 3 November 2026; Universidad de Los Lagos — Advanced, 5 years, expires 9 September 2026; Universidad de Magallanes — Advanced, 5 years, expires 31 December 2028; and Universidad de Playa Ancha de Ciencias de la Educación — Advanced, 5 years, expires 25 May 2027. Universidad de Chile meets the accreditation threshold but follows its preserved DFL 3/2006 professional-title route, so the potential Decree-174 set is the other 13. Article 4 can narrow that set further for Medicine. The four excluded state universities are Universidad de Aysén, Universidad de O’Higgins, UMCE and UTEM because their applicable periods are under five years. None of the 14 qualifying records remained unverified.
answers.quote: A continuación se presenta el buscador avanzado de acreditaciones, en el cual podrá obtener mayor información respecto al tipo de acreditación consultada.
answers.note: CNA’s result interface was live but dynamically rendered. Exact current dates were cross-checked against the official 2026 Comisión Ingresa table at https://portal.ingresa.cl/donde-estudiar-con-cae/renovantes-del-credito/ and official CNA or university decisions.

answers.answer: Ukraine’s Ministry of Education and Science is currently processing apostilles for educational and academic-degree documents, including the diploma, diploma supplement and Candidate of Sciences diploma. They count as three separate documents and physical originals must be mailed after online preliminary review. For an applicant submitting remotely from Chile, the current foreign-applicant tariff is 100 USD or EUR per document for two-working-day processing without an institutional query, or 60 USD or EUR per document for ten working days without a query or twenty working days with a query. For three documents, that is respectively 300 or 180 USD/EUR, plus the individual administrative levy of 51 UAH per apostille—153 UAH total—and international shipping. The operator determines from the scans whether an institutional query is necessary. The tariff page is internally inconsistent on regular processing: its general notice says 40 working days, its office/domestic tables say 30, and the foreign-applicant table lists no regular option; the operator must therefore confirm any regular overseas order. Wartime service has officially operated again since 21 March 2022 and remote submission remains available. The electronic apostille register is only an online verification record; it does not replace the apostille attached to the original document. The receiving authority gets the apostilled original and may verify it in the register.
answers.quote: Кожен документ, на якому має бути проставлений штамп апостиля, вважається окремим документом
answers.note: The official source offers Ukrainian, Russian and English, but no Spanish version; the quote is therefore verbatim Ukrainian. Remote-submission instructions: https://www.apostille.in.ua/ua/procedura-podachi/dystanciina-podacha. Official verification register: https://enic.in.ua/index.php/ua/aporegua. Ministry confirmation: https://mon.gov.ua/en/ministry/services/apostille?=print.

bottom_line: The legal framework and national tariff are in force. Thirteen state universities other than Universidad de Chile meet the institutional threshold for possible Decree-174 professional-title work, subject to Article 4, but the public operational rollout—participating-institution list, applicant guidance and internal platform status—remains unverified.
